title: disktop alerts check --json
description: Reaching a threshold is an expected monitoring outcome and exits 1. An inventory that could not be completed exits 3 instead, because an alert drawn from partial readings is not the whole picture.

thresholdPercent.description: Used-space percentage that raises an alert, from configuration or --threshold.

inodeThresholdPercent.description: Used-inode percentage that raises an alert. Low inodes fail writes even when blocks are free.

alerts.description: Empty when no threshold was reached. Network filesystems are not alerted on; their capacity is not this machine's to reclaim.

filesystems.description: Every filesystem considered, so a caller can see what was and was not checked.
